NumberNote.title: NumberNote
NumberNote.description: User-authored note pinned to a phone number or contact, synced per authenticated user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

phoneNumber.description: Formatted phone number associated with the note.

normalizedNumber.description: Digits-only or E.164 normalized number for fast matching.

contactName.description: Optional resolved contact or caller name.

body.description: Detailed call note or follow-up details.

tags.description: Bounded list of up to 10 short label tags.

pinned.description: Whether the note is pinned for quick display.

CallerTag.title: CallerTag
CallerTag.description: Custom caller identification label, category, and block preference for an unknown or saved number.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

blocked.description: Whether incoming calls from this number should be screened/blocked.

/users/{userId}/callerTags/{tagId}.description: User-isolated collection of custom caller ID tags and block rules.
